title: Zara 'BENITO ANTONIO' Puerto Rico Pop-Up Generates Viral Coverage — Immersive Bubblegum-Pink Store at Plaza Las Américas Draws Crowds
detail: The bubblegum-pink immersive Zara 'BENITO ANTONIO' pop-up store at Plaza Las Américas in San Juan, Puerto Rico — which opened around May 16 following a surprise appearance by Bad Bunny himself — was generating widespread viral coverage by May 18, 2026, ahead of the global collection launch set for midnight ET on May 21. Latin Times published a video feature offering an inside look at the pop-up, showing the transformed store space stocked with pieces from the then-upcoming 150-piece collection. The pop-up offered early exclusive access to select collection items in Puerto Rico before the worldwide launch — a deliberate decision to debut the collection on the island that inspired it, consistent with Bad Bunny's practice of centering Puerto Rico in major cultural moments. The viral footage of the pop-up circulated widely on social media in the days before the global drop, building anticipation ahead of the European stadium leg of the Debí Tirar Más Fotos World Tour, which was then four days away from its Barcelona opening (May 22).
